## History

Magog is a chinaware dog who, along with Gog, was packed away in a box under the spare-room bed at Patty's Place prior to the arrival of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her housemates. The key to unlock the box was sent to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P5](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0005)_
